item: The a11y sweep's colour findings C1-C3: task-manager dimmed text, the agenda's today number and dawn's card-back action now clear 4.5:1 in every theme
refs: PR pending; row 228; a11y sweep 2026-11-20 C1 C2 C3
summary: C1: the task manager dimmed text with opacity (44 nodes below 4.5:1 in light, dawn, mint, paper, solar); it now uses var(--muted) / var(--fg-soft), real colours that clear 4.5:1 on --bg and --panel in every theme. C2: the agenda's today day number uses --accent-text instead of --accent. C3: the card-back Open corpus tint dropped from 22%/34% (hover) to 12%/18%, checked over every theme and all 360 family hues. Release line: Task-manager labels, the agenda's today number and the card-back Open corpus action now meet 4.5:1 text contrast in every theme.
